  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  JUNE 27, 2017

A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Winterer at 4:32 p.m., on
Tuesday, June 27, 2017, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street.

Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Ted Winterer
  Mayor Pro Tem Gleam Davis
  Councilmember Sue Himmelrich
  Councilmember Kevin McKeown
  Councilmember Pam O’Connor (arrived at 4:50 p.m.)
  Councilmember Terry O’Day (arrived at 4:40 p.m.)
  Councilmember Tony Vazquez

  Also Present:  City Manager Rick Cole
  Interim Assistant City Attorney Alan Seltzer
  City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

CONVENE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 4:32 p.m., with all
  members present except Councilmembers O’Connor and O’Day.

CLOSED SESSIONS  Member of the public Denise Barton commented on closed session.
Councilmember O’Day
arrived at 4:40 p.m.  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 4:35 p.m., to consider
  closed sessions and returned at 5:34 p.m., with all members present, to
Councilmember O’Connor  report the following:
arrived at 4:50 p.m.
  1.A. Public Employee Evaluation:
  Title: City Manager

  The Mayor advised this matter was heard with no reportable action taken.

ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting was adjourned at 5:34
  p.m.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  Denise Anderson-Warren  Ted Winterer
  City Clerk  Mayor

  1  June 27, 2017
